verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the ESP32 local 0.1 µF decoupling placement criterion while allowing the 10 µF bulk capacitor to remain in place.
The freelancer disputes the need for the client-requested ESP32 decoupling placement change, creating a material unresolved layout decision.
The client directs that the ESP32 decoupling capacitors retain their existing PCB placement; removing the prior 2 mm limit prevents stale conflicting layout state.
The client resolves the placement conflict by accepting the existing ESP32 decoupling layout, returning the Requirement to active status.
